<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def blockpos(frame):
    a=frame.ascii.split('\n')
    pts=[(r,c) for r in range(16,25) for c in range(17,43) if a[r][c] in ('b','S')]
    if not pts: return None
    cs=[p[1] for p in pts]; rs=[p[0] for p in pts]
    return (min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs))
def timer(frame): return sum(1 for r in range(64) if frame.ascii.split('\n')[r][62]=='N')
print("start:",blockpos(current_frame),"timer:",timer(current_frame))
for i in range(12):
    action(['LEFT'])
    bp=blockpos(current_frame)
    if i%2==0: print(f"L{i+1}:",bp,"t:",timer(current_frame))
print("final:",blockpos(current_frame),"timer:",timer(current_frame))
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
